cells.title: Warn in the prompt-context hook when the session context passes the handoff mark
cells.action: On UserPromptSubmit, the prompt-context hook reads the payload's transcript_path and takes the latest request context (input + cache read + cache creation tokens, as statusline context_and_turns computes it). When that value is at or above handoff_context_tokens from .bee/config.json (integer; absent means 150000; 0 turns the check off), the injected context carries exactly one extra line: `context <N>k tokens is past the handoff mark (<T>k): finish this step, write a planned-next handoff (bee state handoff write --kind planned-next), and continue in a fresh session.` Below the mark, with no transcript_path, or with an unreadable or usage-free transcript, nothing is added and the hook never fails or slows the turn. Reuse context_and_turns rather than a second parser. Record the key and the line in the named knowledge concept. No code comments. One commit with the trailer `cell: lnc-1`.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- prompt_context statusline

truths: a transcript whose latest usage sums to 160000 makes the hook output carry the handoff line naming 160k and 150k
a transcript at 140000 adds no line
handoff_context_tokens 0 adds no line at any size
a missing or unreadable transcript adds no line and the hook exits 0
key_links: a test fails before the change and passes after
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion
Never fail the hook on a transcript read error
open_choices: where in the injected parts the line sits

cells.judge_obligation_ack: the hook only adds an advisory context line; no allow or deny path changes

cells.title: Move the handoff mark to 150k tokens or 65% and run the docs role on sonnet
cells.action: Every doctrine site that names the 65%-context handoff (rule: agents-context-handoff-65) says the mark is about 150k tokens or 65% of the window, whichever comes first, and that every feature close is also a handoff point; the rule id is unchanged. The AGENTS.block.md line under Care for the session carries this, and AGENTS.md is regenerated from it with bee dev regen inside this cell, never hand-edited. The rule index spoken line says the same. In .bee/config.json, team.claude.docs.model becomes sonnet; no other role changes. packages/bee/prompts/worker-cell.md is out of scope. One commit with the trailer `cell: lnc-2`.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee -- agents_md doctrine parity && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: rg -n '65%' over the five skills and AGENTS.block.md shows every hit paired with 150k
AGENTS.md matches bee dev regen output
team.claude.docs.model is sonnet and every other role is unchanged
